verdict.rationale: Zoho Invoice is an invoicing product, so the pricing-model axis applies. The evidence only shows recurring invoices, credit notes applied to invoices, and billable expenses or mileage. Nothing documents tiered, volume, graduated, per-unit, or hybrid subscription-plus-usage pricing, nor prepaid credits, commitments, or overage handling; recurring invoices and credit notes are adjacent features, not this capability.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can price with tiered, volume, graduated, per-unit, and hybrid subscription-plus-usage models — including credits, commitments, and overage — without custom code
